name: Veidos's Erupting Egg of Extinction
desc: If there is a card in the Field Zone, you can discard this card (Quick Effect): Add 1 "Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction" from your Deck to your hand and send 1 "Ashened" card from your Deck to the GY. If "Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction" leaves the field while this card is in the GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Veidos's Erupting Egg of Extinction" once per turn.
strings: Add "Veidos" and send 1 "Ashened" card to GY
Add this card from GY to hand
